name: blitzman
description: A streaming platform engineered for one billion concurrent viewers. Built in public, phase by phase.
author: 0xMudit

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @blitzman/api" "npm run dev -w @blitzman/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @blitzman/api && npm run build -w @blitzman/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @blitzman/api && npm run typecheck -w @blitzman/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @blitzman/api" "npm run start -w @blitzman/web"
